svg.text: Fused detector, one frame at a time: EfficientNet-B0 body + Mamba head
RTX 4060 Ti, fp16, batch 1. Every box is a Triton kernel: all 75 kernels in the measured frame. One CUDA graph replays the whole frame.
1 EfficientNet-B0 body (fused v2 trunk, fp16, NHWC)
x16 MBConv blocks, four kernels each
Activations between kernels are NHWC fp16. The SE gate multiply and the residual add
run inside the project GEMM, so they cost no extra kernels or feature-map passes.
Trunk output: 8 x 8 x 320, then kernel A.
2 Hand-off and Mamba head: kernels A and B, state carried to the next frame
PyTorch version of the same stage: 0.288 ms, 137 kernels
batch 1, one frame; DRAM from Nsight Compute
EfficientNet-B0 latency, ms, one quiet run
Accuracy 89.6% (linear head); with the Mamba head:
SE pooling sums come out of the depthwise
kernel, so the feature map is not re-read.
Kernels A and B replace the PyTorch head:
Not the fastest streaming option: window
attention with random weights is 1.25x faster.
